stop_codes.APPLY_NOT_AUTHORIZED: TARGET write without both apply flags.
stop_codes.TARGET_NOT_DRY_RUN: Non-dry-run TARGET mode outside authorized apply.
stop_codes.CREDENTIAL_SECRET_PRESENT: Credential data/secret field detected in a payload.
stop_codes.SECRET_MATERIAL_IN_EXPORT: PAT, JWT, bot token, or private key in export.
stop_codes.UNMAPPED_CREDENTIAL: A node credential has no TARGET equivalent.
stop_codes.UNMAPPED_DATATABLE: A dataTableId has no TARGET table mapping.
stop_codes.SCHEMA_MISMATCH: SOURCE and TARGET table schemas differ.
stop_codes.SCHEDULE_TRIGGER_WOULD_ENABLE: Prepared TARGET would enable a scheduleTrigger.
stop_codes.DUPLICATE_WORKFLOW_DRIFT: TARGET already has the name with a different logic_sha256.
stop_codes.WEBHOOK_ID_COPY: SOURCE webhookId would be copied to TARGET.
stop_codes.GITHUB_PAT_IN_N8N: GitHub PAT detected in workflow parameters.
